describe: AIVideosUGC is an online tool that turns a product photo, or a public product page link, into store images and short videos. You choose the frame and the length, see the credit cost, and download a file with no watermark. You add captions, prices, and music yourself after download.

faq.a: An online tool for stores. Upload a product photo, or paste a product page link, and download a store image or a short video.
Monthly plans start at $24.50 with 200 credits. Each video or photo shows its credit cost before it starts, and a failed job returns those credits.

faq.q: Does an AIVideosUGC video include a spoken line?
faq.a: Product clips come without narration, music, or captions. Add those in your editor after download. A spokesperson clip is different: the actor says the one line you write, and the mouth movement follows the words. See [AI spokesperson video](page:spokesperson-videos).

faq.q: What video settings can I choose?
faq.a: Choose 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds, and 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3, or 3:4. The same product photo can become a vertical ad, a square clip, or a wide frame.

faq.q: How many credits does a video or photo use?
faq.a: A photo uses 24 credits. Videos use 24 for 6 seconds, 40 for 10 seconds, 60 for 15 seconds, and 120 for 30 seconds. The exact cost is on screen before the job starts.

faq.q: Can I use the results in ads and on my store?
faq.a: Yes. Downloaded photos and videos can be used commercially and have no watermark. You can post them on marketplaces, social platforms, and your own store, under each platform's rules.
